docs.text: Always good times with Frost. 💕 Fun fact, there used to be 6 great lakes but Frost forgot to wear a swim diaper so there are only 5 now. 🤭
One of my favorite parts of winter break is spending a few days in a cabin on Lake Superior with no laptop. No snow this year, but still can't complain about the view.
Early September 2024, Bear Pass Channel, Rainy Lake. The water was still warm enough to swim. Still no snow here.

Winter pics from Lake Michigan in Wisconsin, Lake Erie in Ohio and the Cook Count Forest Preserves in IL. Winter feels peaceful. No allergies, no mosquitoes, no tics, no humidity, all while our green neighbors are napping.
Winter was so cool on Lake Michigan. Those crazy ice donuts!
In 2024 it snowed here in May + I swam in Lake Michigan in October.😂
Winter on Lake Huron a few years ago.
Looks very familiar! The entire month of January has been given up to snow here on Lake Huron, perfect for doomscrolling 😕
Isn't it? I love Lake Huron in winter! ❤️
Lake Huron ? If so it will start ringer cold cold and cold 🥶🥶🥶
Frost a few days ago, now 80s here at the bottom of Lake Huron, too!
Michigan winter on the Great Lakes. Lake Huron
❄️ #Frost to 70s: A Spring Flip in the Great Lakes 🥶. 🗺️ More details here! 👇
It's January. It's January in NE Ohio. It's January in NE Ohio within sight of Lake Erie (I can see a sliver on a clear day, so you can imagine what the higher floors see). We done fucked up...
You know it's been a long, long winter - The ice is still melting on Lake Huron!!!
